brand.name: VYTAL
brand.subtitle: An Explainable, Multilingual Healthcare Decision-Support Platform Integrating Clinical Rules and Machine Learning.

safety.banner: Educational & Research Prototype — NOT A MEDICAL DEVICE. Never diagnose, prescribe, or replace qualified medical professionals.
safety.emergencyCall: If you are experiencing a life-threatening medical emergency, call 108, 112, or local emergency services immediately.

reportExplainer.title: LabLens
reportExplainer.subtitle: Understand your reports.
reportExplainer.description: Upload a PDF laboratory report or enter values manually. Explains test results in simple language with laboratory reference ranges.

idrs.title: RiskPulse
idrs.subtitle: Know your health risk factors.
idrs.description: Calculates the published 4-factor risk score by Mohan and colleagues (JAPI 2005) for South Asian adults.

triage.title: SymptomSense
triage.subtitle: Understand symptoms and warning signs.
triage.description: Deterministic rule engine evaluated with emergency red flags first. Cannot be overridden by lower-priority findings.

medications.title: MedWise
medications.subtitle: Explore medication interactions.
medications.description: RxNorm concept normalization and evidence-backed pairwise interaction reviews with negative finding disclaimers.

summary.title: Vytal360
summary.subtitle: Your complete health overview.
summary.description: Consolidated health brief synthesizing findings across all healthcare modules with downloadable vector PDF.

research.title: Machine Learning Research & Analytics Dashboard
research.subtitle: Algorithmic Benchmarks & Explainability
research.description: Independent ML subsystem benchmarking 4 algorithms with Stratified 5-Fold Cross-Validation on a South Asian cohort.
